test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Consider the following statements:

(a) The red light has a wavelength about 1.8 times greater than the blue light.

(b) When sunlight passes through the atmosphere, the fine particles scatter blue light more strongly than red.

Which of the above statements help(s) us to understand the blue colour of a clear sky?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Both (a) and (b)**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The statement** (b)** helps us to understand the** blue colour** of a **clear sky.**

 
 
• When sunlight passes through the atmosphere, the fine particles present in the air **scatter blue light **more strongly than red.
 
• This is known as **Rayleigh scattering** and it is the reason why the sky appears blue during the day.
 
 
 
• The wavelength of blue light is** shorter **than that of red light, so it gets scattered more easily by the particles in the air.
 
• The wavelength of red light is **approximately 1.8 times longer than that of blue light.**
 
• Because of this, **blue light which has shorter wavelengths than red is more severely scattered by fine air particles when it travels through the atmosphere.**
 
• The** sky appears blue when the scattered blue light reaches our sight**.
 
 
• The difference in wavelengths between red and blue light is important in other contexts, such as the** formation of rainbows.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When** sunlight is refracted** via **raindrops** and catches an observer's eyes, a **rainbow** is created.
 
• Instead of the frequently portrayed "teardrop" shape, the majority of raindrops are **spherical.**
 
• This spherical form creates the** ideal environment** for the appearance of a rainbow.
